approved_model_manifest_artifact.notes: Provide the production HTTPS model-manifest artifact and its exact SHA-256. The manifest must identify model versions, platform artifacts, exact sizes/hashes, licenses, provenance and safety-policy thresholds. Do not substitute an example or unreviewed model.

ios_coreml_safety_model.notes: Validate the exact Core ML safety pre-filter on physical iOS devices against the approved label/threshold policy. Record false-positive/false-negative sampling and confirm that server moderation remains authoritative.

android_mediapipe_safety_model.notes: Validate the exact TFLite/MediaPipe safety pre-filter on physical Android devices against the approved label/threshold policy. Record false-positive/false-negative sampling and confirm that server moderation remains authoritative.

model_license_provenance_and_privacy_rev.notes: Record model publisher/source, license compatibility, model-card/provenance review, dataset/privacy implications and any redistribution restrictions for both production artifacts (iOS and Android safety pre-filter).

representative_accuracy_bias_and_safety_.notes: Document representative safety-classifier evaluation across supported pet species, coat/color variation, image quality and relevant safety classes. The on-device model must remain advisory/defense-in-depth and cannot become the sole moderation authority.

physical_device_latency_memory_and_offli.notes: Verify cold/warm model load, repeated inference memory behavior, cache eviction/re-download, airplane-mode cached inference and app background/foreground behavior on representative release-candidate iOS/Android devices. Warm inference p95 must be <=30 ms on each approved representative device class; record raw benchmark evidence rather than inferring performance from source.
